name: tether_puffer_cuda_v002
hypothesis: Transfer V005 weights into geometry-aware navigation; wider routes, adaptive corner tracking and destination metrics may reduce collisions while PPO learns disturbance compensation.
algorithm: PufferLib 3 PuffeRL transferred Gaussian residual controller
notes: PufferLib 3 compatibility migration retaining NavigationTaskV2 MuJoCo physics, privileged state and rotor/deck/cable contact checks. Transfer V007 final policy, optimizer and normalization. Observation/reward statistics frozen; upstream clamps training reward to [-1,1]. Finite duration treated as terminal because PufferLib 3 advantage kernel ignores separate truncations. Different PPO variant, value clipping, no strict equivalence to SB3. CUDA policy and updates; compiled advantage kernel also runs on CUDA; CPU-only MuJoCo workers fork before CUDA initialization to share library memory. Uncalibrated hardware assumptions. No seconds-scale speed or learning improvement claim.
